chapter_title_en: Going of Tariel and Avtandil to Pridon's
chapter_expert_explanation_en: Tariel and Avtandil ride to Mulghazanzar, playfully test Pridon's vigilance by rounding up his royal horse-herd, and march with Pridon and 300 elite horsemen to the fortress of Kadjeti.

stanzas.georgian_raw_text:
რა გათენდა, გაემართნეს, წაიტანეს ასმათ თანა.
ნურადინის ქვეყანამდის შეისვიან მათ უკანა;
მუნ ვაჭარმან ოქროს ფასად ცხენი მისცა, არ უძღვანა,
და ავთანდილ კმა ყოლაოზად, სხვამცა ვინღა წაიტანა.
stanzas.english_translation: When day dawned they set out; they took Asmat’h with them. Till they came to Nuradin's land they mounted her behind them; there a merchant gave them a horse for a price in gold, he made not a gift of it. As guide Avt’handil sufficed; whom else need he take!
stanzas.expert_explanation_en: Chapter 54 ('Going of Tariel and Avtandil to Pridon's', Stanza 1374; Wardrop Stanza 1350): Part of the narrative sequence in which tariel and Avtandil ride to Mulghazanzar, playfully test Pridon's vigilance by rounding up his royal horse-herd, and march with Pridon and 300 elite horsemen to the fortress of Kadjeti.

stanzas.georgian_raw_text:
იარეს და ზედან შეჰხდეს ნურადინის მეჯოგეთა;
ჯოგი ნახეს, მოეწონა ფრიდონისთვის ეაგეთა.
მუნ ავთანდილს ინდო ეტყვის: “გაქნევ კარგთა სიშმაგეთა,
და მოდი, ფრიდონს ველაღობნეთ, ჯოგსა მისსა მოვადგეთა.
stanzas.english_translation: They wended their way and met with Nuradin's herdsmen, they saw the herd (of horses); it pleased them, who had come for P’hridon. There said the Hindoo to [paragraph continues] Avt’handil: "I will have thee do a good piece of fooling: Come, let us play a joke on P’hridon, let us chase his herd.
stanzas.expert_explanation_en: Chapter 54 ('Going of Tariel and Avtandil to Pridon's', Stanza 1375; Wardrop Stanza 1351): Part of the narrative sequence in which tariel and Avtandil ride to Mulghazanzar, playfully test Pridon's vigilance by rounding up his royal horse-herd, and march with Pridon and 300 elite horsemen to the fortress of Kadjeti.

stanzas.georgian_raw_text:
“ჯოგი წავუღოთ, მოსრულნი ვესმით ჯოგისა წაღებად,
გამოემართვის საომრად, ველთა სისხლისა დაღებად,
ანაზდად გვიცნობს, გაკრთების, გულსა შეჰლამის დაღებად,
და ამოა კარგი ლაღობა, ლაღსა შევეიქმს ლაღებად”.
stanzas.english_translation: "We will carry off the herd, he will come and hear that the herd is reived; he will prepare to do battle, to dye the plain with gore. Suddenly he will recognize us, he will be surprised, he will calm his heart. Pleasant is good joking; it makes even the proud merry."
stanzas.expert_explanation_en: Chapter 54 ('Going of Tariel and Avtandil to Pridon's', Stanza 1376; Wardrop Stanza 1352): Part of the narrative sequence in which tariel and Avtandil ride to Mulghazanzar, playfully test Pridon's vigilance by rounding up his royal horse-herd, and march with Pridon and 300 elite horsemen to the fortress of Kadjeti.

stanzas.georgian_raw_text:
დაუწყეს პყრობა ტაიჭთა ფრიდონის უკეთესებსა.
მუნ მეჯოგეთა ფანოსი შეექმნა, ეკრა კვესებსა;
უყივლეს: “ვინ ხართ, მოყმენო, ვინ იქმთ საქმესა ზესებსა?
და ჯოგი მისია, ვინ მტერსა ჰკრავს ხრმალსა, არ აკვნესებსა”.
stanzas.english_translation: They began to seize the steeds, P’hridon's finest. There the herdsmen made a torch, they struck steel. They shouted: "Who are ye, knights, who do such high (-handed) deeds? This herd is his who strikes the foe with his sword without making him to sigh."
stanzas.expert_explanation_en: Chapter 54 ('Going of Tariel and Avtandil to Pridon's', Stanza 1377; Wardrop Stanza 1353): Part of the narrative sequence in which tariel and Avtandil ride to Mulghazanzar, playfully test Pridon's vigilance by rounding up his royal horse-herd, and march with Pridon and 300 elite horsemen to the fortress of Kadjeti.

stanzas.georgian_raw_text:
მათ მშვილდები დაიწვადეს, მეჯოგეთა გაეკიდნეს.
მეჯოგენი მიიზახდეს, ხმანი მათნი გაადიდნეს:
“გვიშველეთო, გვიშველეთო, მეკობრეთა ამოგვწყვიდნეს!”
და ხმა შეიქმნა, შეიყარნეს, ფრიდონს ჰკადრეს, არ დარიდნეს.
stanzas.english_translation: They seized their bows, they pursued the herdsmen; the herdsmen shrieked aloud, they raised their voices: "Help, help! brigands are massacring us!" They made an outcry, they united, they appealed to P’hridon, they were not bashful.
stanzas.expert_explanation_en: Chapter 54 ('Going of Tariel and Avtandil to Pridon's', Stanza 1378; Wardrop Stanza 1354): Part of the narrative sequence in which tariel and Avtandil ride to Mulghazanzar, playfully test Pridon's vigilance by rounding up his royal horse-herd, and march with Pridon and 300 elite horsemen to the fortress of Kadjeti.

stanzas.georgian_raw_text:
შეეკაზმა ფრიდონ, შეჯდა, შეკაზმული გამოვიდა.
ხმა შეიქმნა, შეიყარნეს, რაზმი ველთა დაჰფარვიდა.
იგი მზენი მოეგებნეს, ვის ზამთარი ვერ დაჰზვრიდა;
და დაეხურა ზარადები, პირსა მათსა უფარვიდა.
stanzas.english_translation: P’hridon arrayed himself, he mounted, he rode forth in full array. They made an outcry, they united, the regiment covered the fields. Those suns whom winter could not freeze came forward; they were covered up, helmets hid their faces.
stanzas.expert_explanation_en: Chapter 54 ('Going of Tariel and Avtandil to Pridon's', Stanza 1379; Wardrop Stanza 1355): Part of the narrative sequence in which tariel and Avtandil ride to Mulghazanzar, playfully test Pridon's vigilance by rounding up his royal horse-herd, and march with Pridon and 300 elite horsemen to the fortress of Kadjeti.

stanzas.georgian_raw_text:
რა ტარიელ ფრიდონ იცნა, თქვა: “ვნახეო, ვინცა მინა”.
მუზარადი მოიხადა, გაიღიმა, გაიცინა;
ფრიდონს უთხრა: “რასა ჰლამი, ჩვენი მოსლვა რას გეწყინა?
და პურად ავი მასპინძელი მოგვეგებვი ომად წინა!”
stanzas.english_translation: When Tariel knew P’hridon, "Now have I seen him I want," said he; he raised his helm, he smiled, he laughed; he said to P’hridon: "What dost thou wish? Why doth our coming annoy thee? Bad host! Thou meetest us to fight."
stanzas.expert_explanation_en: Chapter 54 ('Going of Tariel and Avtandil to Pridon's', Stanza 1380; Wardrop Stanza 1356): Part of the narrative sequence in which tariel and Avtandil ride to Mulghazanzar, playfully test Pridon's vigilance by rounding up his royal horse-herd, and march with Pridon and 300 elite horsemen to the fortress of Kadjeti.

stanzas.georgian_raw_text:
ფრიდონ ფიცხლა გარდაიჭრა, დავარდა და თაყვანი სცა.
იგინიცა გარდაუხდეს, მოეხვივნეს, აკოცისცა.
ფრიდონ ღმერთსა ხელ-აპყრობით უსაზომო მადლი მისცა,
და დიდებულნი აკოცებდეს, იცნობდიან იგი ვისცა.
stanzas.english_translation: P’hridon swiftly dismounted; he fell down and saluted. They also alighted, they embraced--ay, kissed him. P’hridon with upraised hand gave God measureless thanks. The magnates also kissed them, whoever knew them.
stanzas.expert_explanation_en: Chapter 54 ('Going of Tariel and Avtandil to Pridon's', Stanza 1381; Wardrop Stanza 1357): Part of the narrative sequence in which tariel and Avtandil ride to Mulghazanzar, playfully test Pridon's vigilance by rounding up his royal horse-herd, and march with Pridon and 300 elite horsemen to the fortress of Kadjeti.

stanzas.georgian_raw_text:
ფრიდონ უთხრა: “რასა სდეგით, მოგელოდი უწინარე,
მე მზა ვარო, სამსახური თქვენი რამცა დავიზარე!”
ჰგვანდა, თუცა შეყრილ იყვნეს ორნი მზენი, ერთი მთვარე,
და ერთმანერთი დააშვენეს, გაემართნეს, იქცეს გარე.
stanzas.english_translation: P’hridon said: "Why tarried ye? I expected ye sooner. I am ready; I shall not lag in any service of yours!" It seemed as if two suns and a moon were united there; they beautified one another. They set out, they departed.
stanzas.expert_explanation_en: Chapter 54 ('Going of Tariel and Avtandil to Pridon's', Stanza 1382; Wardrop Stanza 1358): Part of the narrative sequence in which tariel and Avtandil ride to Mulghazanzar, playfully test Pridon's vigilance by rounding up his royal horse-herd, and march with Pridon and 300 elite horsemen to the fortress of Kadjeti.

stanzas.georgian_raw_text:
ფრიდონის სახლსა გარდახდეს ორნივე, ტურფად გებულსა.
ახლოს დაისვამს ავთანდილს, მისსა ძმად-შეფიცებულსა.
ტარიელ დაჯდა საჯდომსა, ოქსინო-გარდაგებულსა,
და მათ უძღვნეს იგი აბჯარი ფრიდონს, ჭაბუკად ქებულსა.
stanzas.english_translation: At P’hridon's fairly-builded house they both alighted; he sits down beside his sworn brother Avt’handil; Tariel sat on a throne covered in cloth of gold. To P’hridon, renowned as a hero, they presented that armour.
stanzas.expert_explanation_en: Chapter 54 ('Going of Tariel and Avtandil to Pridon's', Stanza 1383; Wardrop Stanza 1359): Part of the narrative sequence in which tariel and Avtandil ride to Mulghazanzar, playfully test Pridon's vigilance by rounding up his royal horse-herd, and march with Pridon and 300 elite horsemen to the fortress of Kadjeti.

stanzas.georgian_raw_text:
უთხრეს: “ჯერ ჟამად არა გვაქვს სხვა შენთვის არმაღანია,
მაგრა ტურფანი მრავალნი ქვე სადმე გვისხენ სხვანია”.
მან დასდვა პირი მიწასა, არ დაიყოვნა ხანია:
და “ჩემთვის ამისი ბოძება არს თქვენი შესაგვანია”.
stanzas.english_translation: They said: "At this time we have no other gifts for thee, but we have many other fair things lying in a place (we wot of)." He laid his face to the ground, he wasted not time: "Such a gift to me is worthy of you."
stanzas.expert_explanation_en: Chapter 54 ('Going of Tariel and Avtandil to Pridon's', Stanza 1384; Wardrop Stanza 1360): Part of the narrative sequence in which tariel and Avtandil ride to Mulghazanzar, playfully test Pridon's vigilance by rounding up his royal horse-herd, and march with Pridon and 300 elite horsemen to the fortress of Kadjeti.

stanzas.georgian_raw_text:
გამოისვენეს მას ღამით ფრიდონის მასპინძლობითა;
აბანოს ბანნა, აავსნა შესამოსლისა ძღვნობითა,
დამოსნა ტურფა-ტურფითა, ერთმანერთისა მჯობითა,
და თვალ-მარგალიტი ღარიბი უძღვნა ოქროსა გობითა.
stanzas.english_translation: That night they rested as P’hridon's guests; baths he gave them, he gave them gifts of garments in plenty, he clad their beauty in beauty, each (garment) fairer than the other; he gave them rare jewels and pearls in a golden basin.
stanzas.expert_explanation_en: Chapter 54 ('Going of Tariel and Avtandil to Pridon's', Stanza 1385; Wardrop Stanza 1361): Part of the narrative sequence in which tariel and Avtandil ride to Mulghazanzar, playfully test Pridon's vigilance by rounding up his royal horse-herd, and march with Pridon and 300 elite horsemen to the fortress of Kadjeti.

stanzas.georgian_raw_text:
უთხრა თუ: “ესე სიტყვაა ავისა მასპინძელისა, —
ჰგავს, მოსწყენოდეს სტუმრობა თქვენ ბრძნისა, ვითა ხელისა,
მაგრა აწ ყოვნა არ ვარგა, წავლა სჯობს გზისა გრძელისა,
და თუ ქაჯნი მოგვესწრებიან, საეჭვი არს სიძნელისა.
stanzas.english_translation: He said: "This (that I am about to say) is the speech of a bad host; ’tis as if hospitality to you wise (ones) wearied me as if you were mad (ones); but tarrying now avails not, it is better to travel the long road; if the Kadjis outstrip us there is a risk of trouble.
stanzas.expert_explanation_en: Chapter 54 ('Going of Tariel and Avtandil to Pridon's', Stanza 1386; Wardrop Stanza 1362): Part of the narrative sequence in which tariel and Avtandil ride to Mulghazanzar, playfully test Pridon's vigilance by rounding up his royal horse-herd, and march with Pridon and 300 elite horsemen to the fortress of Kadjeti.

stanzas.english_translation: "Why should we use great hosts? We want good and few; three hundred men suffice us, let us go (swift) like runaways; in Kadjet’hi for fighting the Kadjis we shall put basket-hilts on our swords; soon shall we find her whose pleasant aloe form will slay us.
stanzas.expert_explanation_en: Chapter 54 ('Going of Tariel and Avtandil to Pridon's', Stanza 1387; Wardrop Stanza 1363): Part of the narrative sequence in which tariel and Avtandil ride to Mulghazanzar, playfully test Pridon's vigilance by rounding up his royal horse-herd, and march with Pridon and 300 elite horsemen to the fortress of Kadjeti.

stanzas.georgian_raw_text:
“ქაჯეთს ერთხელ კვლაც ყოფილვარ, ჰნახავთ, თქვენცა გემაგრების,
ყოვლგნით კლდეა, გარეშემო მტერი ვერა მოადგების;
თუ იდუმალ არ შევუვალთ, ცხადად შებმა არ ეგების,
და მით ლაშქარი არად გვინდა, რაზმი მალვით ვერ მოგვყვების”.
stanzas.english_translation: "Once aforetime I was in Kadjet’hi; you shall see it, and you, too, shall find it strong; on all sides round about is rock, a foe may not come up to it; if we may not go in privily, it is impossible to engage openly; so we need no army, the squadron cannot follow us secretly."
stanzas.expert_explanation_en: Chapter 54 ('Going of Tariel and Avtandil to Pridon's', Stanza 1388; Wardrop Stanza 1364): Part of the narrative sequence in which tariel and Avtandil ride to Mulghazanzar, playfully test Pridon's vigilance by rounding up his royal horse-herd, and march with Pridon and 300 elite horsemen to the fortress of Kadjeti.

stanzas.georgian_raw_text:
იგინიცა დაემოწმნეს ამა მისსა ნაუბარსა.
მუნ დააგდეს ქალი ასმათ; ფრიდონ მისცემს საჩუქარსა.
თვით სამასსა ცხენოსანსა წაიტანდეს, გმირთა დარსა;
და ბოლოდ ღმერთი გაუმარჯვებს ყოვლსა, პირველ შენაზარსა.
stanzas.english_translation: With what he said, they too agreed. They left there the maiden Asmat’h; P’hridon bestows a gift upon her. They took with them three hundred horsemen equal to heroes. At the last God will give the victory to all who have been distressed.
stanzas.expert_explanation_en: Chapter 54 ('Going of Tariel and Avtandil to Pridon's', Stanza 1389; Wardrop Stanza 1365): Part of the narrative sequence in which tariel and Avtandil ride to Mulghazanzar, playfully test Pridon's vigilance by rounding up his royal horse-herd, and march with Pridon and 300 elite horsemen to the fortress of Kadjeti.

stanzas.english_translation: All three sworn brothers crossed the sea. P’hridon knows the way; going day and night they travel. P’hridon said: "Now are we coming nigh the regions of Kadjet’hi; henceforth we must travel by night so that we be not discovered."
stanzas.expert_explanation_en: Chapter 54 ('Going of Tariel and Avtandil to Pridon's', Stanza 1390; Wardrop Stanza 1366): Part of the narrative sequence in which tariel and Avtandil ride to Mulghazanzar, playfully test Pridon's vigilance by rounding up his royal horse-herd, and march with Pridon and 300 elite horsemen to the fortress of Kadjeti.

stanzas.georgian_raw_text:
ამა ფრიდონის თათბირსა სამნივე ერთგან ჰზმიდიან:
რა გაუთენდის, დადგიან და ღამით ფიცხლად ვლიდიან;
მივიდეს, აჩნდა ქალაქი. მცველთა ვერ დასთვალვიდიან,
და გარე კლდე იყო, გუშაგთა ხმა ჯარვით გაადიდიან.
stanzas.english_translation: The three behaved according to this advice of P’hridon's; when it was daylight they stopped, and by night they went swiftly on. They arrived; the city appeared; they could not count the guards; outside was a rock, the noise of the sentinels in crowds increased.
stanzas.expert_explanation_en: Chapter 54 ('Going of Tariel and Avtandil to Pridon's', Stanza 1391; Wardrop Stanza 1367): Part of the narrative sequence in which tariel and Avtandil ride to Mulghazanzar, playfully test Pridon's vigilance by rounding up his royal horse-herd, and march with Pridon and 300 elite horsemen to the fortress of Kadjeti.

stanzas.english_translation: At the gate of the passage ten thousand braves kept guard. Those lions saw the city; the shining moon stood upon it. They said: "Let us advise what is best, now is choice difficult; a hundred can overcome a thousand if they choose the best way."
stanzas.expert_explanation_en: Chapter 54 ('Going of Tariel and Avtandil to Pridon's', Stanza 1392; Wardrop Stanza 1368): Part of the narrative sequence in which tariel and Avtandil ride to Mulghazanzar, playfully test Pridon's vigilance by rounding up his royal horse-herd, and march with Pridon and 300 elite horsemen to the fortress of Kadjeti.

act_title: Act V: Storming of Kadjeti, Liberation & Royal Weddings

location.desc: Coastal kingdom of sworn brother Nuradin Pridon near the maritime crossroads.

key_maxim_en: Verily they rejoiced who had passed through their sorrows.
